expected_findings.rationale: Aspartame is not one of the 14 regulated allergens; no allergen from the list is present in this product.
Aspartame is present but no phenylalanine warning statement appears anywhere on the label.

trap: The capitalised, E-number-annotated aspartame entry looks similar in style to a properly emphasised allergen, which can lead a system to either misclassify it as an allergen matter (and check the wrong rule) or to assume its prominent styling itself satisfies some kind of warning requirement, when the actual required warning text is entirely separate and absent.
notes: UK counterpart to IN-006, testing the sweetener/warning trigger path specifically, distinct from the allergen path.
